projects.title: Project Apollo
projects.description: The goal of this project was to create a generally applicable system to predict the quarterly revenue of blue chip companies based on 38 publicly and non-company specific national economic, social, political, and environmental features. As proof of concept 20 years of quarterly revenues from Starbucks, Ford, and AT&T were statistically tested against the selected features. A kbest feature selector was then used to send the relevant features to a series of cross validated and gird searched machine learning regression models (LassoLars, polynomial, and generalized linear model) and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network (for regression). The MLP produced the best results with following RMSE scores (in billions of dollars): Starbucks: 0.4 versus 2.1 baseline, Ford: 5.4 versus 9.5 baseline, and AT&T: 4.9 versus 10.9 baseline. The MLP was run on July 20, 2023 to predict 2023 Q2 revenues (before the actual corporate revenues were released) with the following outcomes (in billions of dollars):  Starbucks: $9.00 predicted versus $9.17 actual, Ford: $43.70 predicted versus $44.95 actual, AT&T $31.02 predicted versus $29.92 actual.

projects.title: Viral App Predictor
projects.description: This project was created to test several (classification and regression) models to predict the likelihood that an app, once it hits 1 thousand downloads, can reach 1 million downloads. I analyzed 189,000 rows of google store app data from 2020 -2021 and removed all features that did not pass the appropriate statistical test for correlation. After that, features were selected based on my domain knowledge and a kbest model. Once baseline (97.96%) was beat by using a random forest model with an accuracy of 97.98% I experimented with an ensemble of random forests (random forest of random forests) by using 3 random forest (with different random seeds set) and the scikit-learn ensemble voting classifier to attempt to increase overall model accuracy. While it did beat baseline with an accuracy score of 97.98 the precision score dropped from 77% (on the vanilla random forest) to 75%.
